thread:
alex: Midday handoff — quick cover + watchlist. Heads up on a few noisy signals and a couple low-risk degradations. TL;DR: kv-socket churn => intermittent ERROR-503 logs (noise), prefix-cache metric fuzziness still present, and we suppressed a spurious canary alert on us-east1-gpu yesterday. No pager escalation planned unless error rate > 2% or >3 hosts impacted. :wave:

marta: taking evening coverage (18:00-02:00 PT). I'll watch key queues and autoscaler. ping me for any route-fallbacks. :+1:

sam: quick Q — does PR#348 (batch-size tweak) change batching config used by the canary? If so we should note it in the rollout notes.

alex: @sam PR#348 only changes the default target_batch_size for Llama-2x and should be behind the canary flag. No global rollout yet. If you want, drop the flag into the canary tomorrow for a 1hr run.

jin: saw p95 spikes on kv-read around 03:10 UTC this morning — correlate with noisy socket reconnects. Not systemic but increases token-latency for some cold-starts.

alex: logged as follow-up: ticket INF-542. Action: Jin to add a small retry jitter on reconnects today (low-risk).

eva: dashboards: I've added a quick panel showing socket-reconnect rates vs kv-read p95. URL: https://dash.redwood/teams/infra/sockets (internal). Helps spot correlation quickly. :eyes:

oncall-bot: Alert suppression created by alex: suppression_id=sp-2026-04-11-07, targets=[canary-cpu-us-east1-gpu], window=6h, reason="spurious canary due to infra noise"

sam: noted — I'll hold PR merge until after the canary run if we flip the flag.

marta: ETA for my handoff takeover: 18:00 PT. Leaving a few runbook pointers here: 1) If kv-socket ERROR-503 > 1% sustained for 10m, flip routing to kv-fallback pool. 2) If prefix-cache fuzziness causes more than 3 route mismatches/minute, disable prefix-cache-prefetch temporarily. 3) Contact infra-ops for any host-level kernel OOM signs.

alex: +1 to runbook. Also note: autoscaler has been noisier on short spikes — avoid aggressive scale-ups for single short bursts. Using a 3m smoothing window is recommended until we finish the autoscaler tuning RFC.

jin: added a tiny log snippet to the ticket for context:
```
[2026-04-11T03:10:12Z] kv-socket: WARN reconnect attempt=5 err=EOF local=10.2.3.45 remote=10.9.1.2
[2026-04-11T03:10:12Z] kv-read: ERROR code=503 id=abc123 req=ping_seq
```

marta: thanks. I'll keep the look and will escalate if the error baseline drifts up.

eva: FYI to dashboards/alerts owners: lower-priority alerts on prefix-cache have been adjusted to reduce noise — threshold moved from 0.5%->1.5% route-mismatch. We can revert if we miss real regressions.

alex: final note — no critical customer impact reported. If anything crosses the thresholds in the runbook, page the oncall channel and escalate to SRE pager. Otherwise mark as watch and post updates here. :clipboard:

marta: confirmed, will post an update at 22:00 PT with status. :alarm_clock:
